<b>Statisk batching</b>: en batch körs t: Static batching: a batch runs until the longest sequence is done. Slots for sequences that have finished sit empty.
<b>Continuous batching</b>: schedulern b: Continuous batching: the scheduler decides the batch again in every step. A slot that frees up is filled immediately by the next request in the queue.

Token-budget per steg. Styr balansen mel: Token budget per step. Controls the balance between TTFT and ITL via chunked prefill. A higher value reserves more memory for activations and leaves a smaller KV pool.
Antal GPU:er som delar varje lager. Bör: Number of GPUs that split each layer. Should divide the number of KV heads evenly, otherwise KV has to be duplicated.

Det finns fler sätt att dela upp arbetet: There are more ways to split the work across GPUs: by floor, by copy or by expert.
<b>Pipeline parallel</b>: lager 0–15 på: Pipeline parallel: layers 0–15 on one GPU, 16–31 on the next. Little communication (only the stream between stages), works between servers. Needs several batches in flight so that every stage has work.
<b>Data parallel</b>: hela modellen kopi: Data parallel: the whole model is copied, and each copy takes its own requests. Best for throughput when the model fits.
<b>Expert parallel</b>: för MoE. Experte: Expert parallel: for MoE. The experts are distributed, and tokens are sent where they belong with all-to-all.
Tumregel: TP inom en server, PP mellan s: Rule of thumb: TP within a server, PP between servers, DP for more users, EP for large MoE models. Large deployments combine them.
Tre sätt att dela arbete: pipeline per l: Three ways to split the work: pipeline by layer, data parallel with copies, expert parallel with experts per GPU
